body.title: Use isolated worktrees for estate scout hook PRs
body.summary: Hook-only PRs must come from clean origin/main worktrees when local clones have WIP on feature branches.
body.canonicalQuestion: How do I install scout hooks without touching unrelated local changes?

body.shortAnswer: Hook-only PRs must come from clean origin/main worktrees when local clones have WIP on feature branches.
body.detailedAnswer: Use isolated worktrees for estate scout hook PRs

futureAgentInstructions.whenThisAppears: Local repo has feature-branch WIP and estate hook sync is required
